title: The digest reports context rot and decision disagreement
goal: kbusage.py tree reports, per manager tick and per runner, the compactions (compact_boundary events with preTokens), tokens per tick and reads repeated within one tick; the autopilot digest adds the share of autopilot decisions the operator reverted and those contradicting an earlier decision of the same class

gates.question: What is one manager tick in kbusage tree's context-rot report?
options: one prompt (promptId) of the manager transcript, one /loop firing, numbered per transcript
one entry of the autopilot's ticks.jsonl
gates.recommendation: one prompt (promptId) of the manager transcript, one /loop firing, numbered per transcript
gates.answer: one prompt (promptId) of the manager transcript, one /loop firing, numbered per transcript

gates.question: How are a tick's and a runner's tokens counted?
options: uncached input plus cache write plus cache read plus output, once per request, with a tick's subagent transcripts included
fresh input (uncached plus cache write) plus output only
gates.recommendation: uncached input plus cache write plus cache read plus output, once per request, with a tick's subagent transcripts included
gates.answer: uncached input plus cache write plus cache read plus output, once per request, with a tick's subagent transcripts included

gates.question: When does an autopilot decision contradict an earlier one?
options: an earlier autopilot decision in force with the same gate id and the same class has a different answer
any earlier decision of the same class has a different answer, whatever the gate id
gates.recommendation: an earlier autopilot decision in force with the same gate id and the same class has a different answer
gates.answer: an earlier autopilot decision in force with the same gate id and the same class has a different answer
